title: Combining segment invariants
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine, $F$ a set of states, and $P,Q$ predicates on work-tape head positions. If the same run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps, avoids $F$ before time $t$, satisfies $P$ throughout times $0$ through $t$, and also satisfies $Q$ throughout those times, then it satisfies both $P$ and $Q$ throughout times $0$ through $t$; thus it is a segment relative to $F$ and the predicate $p\mapsto P(p)\land Q(p)$.
hypotheses_covered: A segment from $a$ to $b$ of length $t$ relative to $F$ and $P$
